gloss: slide (into a base); making it just in time

definitions.explanation: The act of sliding into something, especially a runner's slide into a base in baseball.

definitions.gloss: making it just in time; last-minute arrival
definitions.explanation: Arriving or getting something done at the very last moment, just before a deadline or a door closes. Usually used as {滑|すべ}り{込|こ}みで or in compounds such as {滑|すべ}り{込|こ}みセーフ.

examples.japanese: ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{滑|すべ}り{込|こ}みだった。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{滑|すべ}り{込|こ}みをした。
{二塁|にるい}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{滑|すべ}り{込|こ}みで、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧をけがした。
examples.english: The player hurt his leg sliding into second base.

examples.japanese: {滑|すべ}り{込|こ}みセーフだった。
examples.english: I made it just in time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦{直前|ちょくぜん}に→直前に：23136_chokuzenni⟧{滑|すべ}り{込|こ}みで⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧した。
examples.english: I sent in my application at the last minute before the deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}って→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧、チーム⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{滑|すべ}り{込|こ}みでプレー⟦オフ→オフ：10733_ofu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: By winning the final game, the team squeaked into the playoffs.

notes:
The noun form of {滑|すべ}り⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to slide into; to slip in just in time). The baseball call セーフ (safe) gave the everyday phrase {滑|すべ}り{込|こ}みセーフ, which is used for any narrow escape from being late.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滑|すべ}り{込|こ}みセーフ: made it just in time (casual)
- {滑|すべ}り{込|こ}みで⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧: to make it at the last moment
- {滑|すべ}り{込|こ}みで⟦{合格|ごうかく}する→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧: to just barely pass
- ヘッドスライディング: head-first slide (baseball)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}み→駆け込み：08295_kakekomi⟧: rushing in — stresses hurrying at the last minute, as in ⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ}→駆け込み乗車：08488_kakekomijousha⟧ (dashing onto a train); {滑|すべ}り{込|こ}み stresses that one only just made it.
- ぎりぎり: barely, at the limit — a general adverb for narrow margins.
